about.vintageAlt: Historic street scene with the bakery
about.interiorAlt: Bakers at work in the traditional bakery
about.storyP1: Since 1986, Bäckerei Zwick has stood for genuine baking craftsmanship, traditional recipes, and a love of baking.
about.storyP2: What began with our grandfather is now carried on by the next generation with the same passion and dedication. From father to son, our craft and values are passed down from one generation to the next.
about.storyP3: We place great importance on quality, freshness, and traditional preparation. With experience, careful handwork, and selected ingredients, we bake goods every day that bring tradition and flavor together.
about.storyPromise: Three generations. One passion. One promise: genuine craftsmanship since 1986.
about.invitationText: Stop by and enjoy a good cup of coffee with a delicious slice of cake. We look forward to welcoming you!
